channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: School personnel changes approved
item.description: Wilson County school board approved February personnel changes Feb. 16, including a new executive director of school nutrition, multiple teacher hires and several resignations and a retirement.

item.title: City seeks input on downtown parking
item.description: The city of Wilson is asking residents to weigh in on downtown parking as growth boosts demand; an online survey will inform a new parking study and guide future management decisions.

item.title: Liberation Day for real? Not really
item.description: A Supreme Court ruling confirms Trump’s “Liberation Day” tariffs exceeded presidential powers, but delays, dissents and lack of restitution show how little relief victims can expect.

item.title: Carolinians thwarted Britain’s southern gambit
item.description: In 1776 at Moores Creek Bridge, North Carolina militia crushed a Loyalist force meant to anchor Britain’s Southern Strategy, derailing plans to reclaim the Carolinas.

item.title: The Allam-Foushee primary and the nature of progress
item.description: In North Carolina’s 4th District, the Nida Allam-Valerie Foushee primary highlights how a fraught history, civil rights activism and economic change have shaped a rare hub of Southern liberalism.

item.title: ‘Too big to fail,’ yet it will
item.description: A 240-million-gallon sewage spill into the Potomac exposes the hidden flaw of America’s centralized wastewater systems — and why decentralized treatment could limit the damage.

item.title: Our Opinion: City of Wilson earns kudos for mall demolition
item.description: Thumbs up to the city of Wilson for tearing down the Wilson Mall; thumbs down to red tape delaying the adoption of eVTOL aircraft that Sen. Ted Budd, R-N.C., is working to cut.

item.title: Driver in critical condition after crash, shooting
item.description: Road rage on Interstate 587 ends with crash and shooting; Wilson County officials say one driver allegedly forced another off the road before being shot and hospitalized. The case remains under investigation.

item.title: Police: Teen, juvenile caught with arsenal of guns
item.description: Traffic stop in Wilson nets ghost gun and Drako rifle after 19-year-old, juvenile flee; Rogeravion Jones held on $80,000 bond, already facing 14 counts of discharging a weapon into an occupied property.
